answer: The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in karst, expire in ocean, and quill lists each expiry. Anyone running 27 aliases therefore needs 67 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1368 identities would post 3380 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
